records.subject: spec-guard-release-artifact
evidence: result:the package was built from the v0.31.0 tag with git archive of .claude-plugin and plugins/spec-guard plus ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json, the method that rebuilt v0.24.0 file-for-file identical to its published asset
result:release-package.py validated the artifact directory before archiving and again after extracting the archive; the archive contains no AppleDouble entries
result:the locally built archive and the downloaded published GitHub asset both have SHA-256 8a9ba01560a19e70232f6bc568aa93b8b0906f20487b54f9f8307b6d35a0f275, matching the digest GitHub reports

content:hooks/proposal_publication.py in the package isolates already-promoted Proposals that fail validation into PublicationPool.skipped and serializes them with skipped_as_json; the promotion proof and mainline review hooks emit skippedProposals
result:the required GitHub Actions checks validate (ubuntu-latest) and validate (macos-latest) passed on 0e5e865, the release pull request head whose tree is identical to the tagged merge commit
